programs.description: Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
The host provides the latest socio-economic and political news, updates and developments from various parts of the world.
Bhama falls in love with Shankaran, but she is forced to marry another man. However, her life takes a turn when she discovers that her husband is already married.
Tony, a former outlaw, decides to lead a quiet life with his wife and newborn child. However, their peaceful household is disrupted after the return of a dangerous gangster, Prakash.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
The host prepares regional dishes for Onam, showcasing recipes and discussing the festival's significance.
Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.
48th Soorya Festival 2025
An unemployed man living in Germany receives an opportunity to organise a star-studded event in Kerala. However, chaos ensues when he arrives in the country.
Four friends are nothing but timid, petty thieves trying to get by for a living. Things change drastically for them when they get caught in the act of stealing.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Etho Janma Kalpanayil
Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.
While juggling her roles of being a great teacher and a devoted mother, a woman remains desperate for the affection she has always yearned for but never received.
A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
Follow the story of six youngsters as they navigate through happiness, heartbreaks and all the challenges that life throws at them.
